basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a casual gamer and a huge fan of Animal Crossing. I live in the Midwest and work as a graphic designer during the day. I love exploring new hobbies and connecting with people over shared interests. Besides gaming, I'm intrigued by the unexplained, which explains my interest in abductions and other mysteries. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time either gaming or watching documentaries on Discovery Plus.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in gaming comes from years of personal interest and self-teaching. I started with basic games and gradually moved to more immersive ones like Animal Crossing. My curiosity about unexplained phenomena is fueled by documentaries and online articles, which I consume avidly.
